purpose: Publish traceable actual research stages, including scientific failure or pre-execution blocking, without promotion to reviewed scientific results
unknown_numeric_policy: null with reason; never substitute zero for an uncomputed quantity

scientific_boundaries.published_authorship: Original chemical findings and observations retain their original authors

evidence_identity.S1: Evidence archive and public research records
evidence_identity.S2: Page/data revision referencing known S1 evidence; not the execution commit
evidence_identity.fixed_URL_policy: Use full S1 SHA for evidence blob URLs; locally retained archives have no fabricated download URL

local_test_distribution_policy: tests/ and test/ remain local; CI must not claim to run them
